title: onprem/airgap: vendor offline bundle updates for rke2 flatcar + efi + ol support
author: Maya Singh
description: Motivation: customer rollouts to enterprise on-prem environments revealed two gaps in the current offline bundle: missing EFI-friendly initramfs for newer Flatcar images, and missing Oracle Linux (OL) artifacts required by an enterprise partner. This PR vendors an updated offline bundle that includes: (1) rke2 1.27-compatible binaries, (2) Flatcar images with EFI support and signed TUF metadata, (3) Oracle Linux 9 base images and containerd patches, and (4) updated Helm charts and installer scripts to detect and bootstrap EFI+OL nodes. The change is focused on artifact vendoring and installer logic; no API changes. Checklist: - [x] vendor new rke2 and linux images into offline bundle - [x] include TUF metadata and signatures for all new artifacts - [x] update airgap installer to support EFI boot detection and pathing - [x] add OL-related preflight checks and containerd workaround for CVE-2025-xxxx - [x] update Terraform module to support new bundle S3 layout - [x] integration test: airgap install on k3s/rke2-flatcar pipeline (passed on rerun) Backwards compatibility: installer detects legacy non-EFI nodes and falls back to legacy path. No customer action required except re-downloading the new offline bundle for new installs. Deployment notes: patch release for v1.12 offline bundles; customers with existing installs do not need upgrade unless switching to OL images or EFI booted nodes.
